about: Arnprior is a town in Renfrew County, Ontario, where the Madawaska River meets the Ottawa, west of Ottawa. Mill and lumber heritage, Gillies Grove old-growth, and a downtown on the two rivers define this Ottawa Valley community. Neighbouring McNab/Braeside Township is a separate municipality. About 10,000 people live in Arnprior.
